checkUnknownElements.title: Warn about @PayloadRoot elements missing from the schemas
checkUnknownElements.description: Warn when a @PayloadRoot localPart names no top-level element in the project schemas of its namespace.

checkMissingResources.title: Report schema files missing from the resources
checkMissingResources.description: Info when a ClassPathResource or XML schema location is not in src/main/resources or src/test/resources. It may come from a dependency.

checkRequestResponsePairs.title: Report Request elements without a matching Response
checkRequestResponsePairs.description: Info when an XxxRequest element has no XxxResponse element, which DefaultWsdl11Definition needs to build the Xxx operation.

checkWsdlDefinitions.title: Check DefaultWsdl11Definition beans and WSDL references
checkWsdlDefinitions.description: Warn about a missing portTypeName or schema, a missing locationUri, and WSDL references that resolve to nothing.
